title: Crypto Trading Signals - September 01, 2026
top_story_headline: Singapore MAS proposes stablecoin licensing framework under Payment Services Act amendments; public feedback open until October 16.
top_story_comment: The issuer-yield ban pushes reserve spread to distribution platforms such as Global Dollar Network. Paxos Digital Singapore’s USDG already runs that play under MAS supervision. GDN said on July 21 that 150+ partners can receive up to 100% of reserve rewards on more than $3 billion in circulation.
